title: Accounting and Tax Services for Laundry Businesses

rows.before: We incorporated under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the assets across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, and capitalized the equipment as Class 8 and the fit-out as Class 13 leasehold improvements.
rows.after: We incorporated under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the assets across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), and capitalized the equipment as Class 8 and the fit-out as Class 13 leasehold improvements.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).
